name: 011_re_observation_confidence
description: A fact re-observed multiple times and stated most recently wins a contradiction.

episodes.text:
User: I tried Emacs keybindings for a week and thought they were better than Vim.
Assistant: Interesting take.

User: Actually I prefer Vim keybindings.
Assistant: Many power users agree.

User: I use Vim keybindings everywhere — VS Code, Jupyter, even my browser.
Assistant: Committed!

User: Seriously, Vim keybindings changed how I work. I can't go back.
Assistant: They become second nature.

provenance_checks.episode_hint: Vim keybindings changed how I work
